theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (s h : ℝ) (ξ : Euclid (n + k) → MultiVector (n + k) n) (β : Euclid (n + k) → Covector (Euclid (n + k)) n), 0 < n → R.Represents T → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → 0 < s → 0 < h → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 s) → {x | ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ∃ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) h, x = z + ι v + ι' w} ⊆ U → R.measure.support ∩ {x | ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ∃ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) h, x = z + ι v + ι' w} = (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) s → ContinuousOn β ((fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) s) → (∀ x ∈ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ξ x (β x) = 1) → (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, IsUnitOrientationOf (ξ (z + ι v + ι' (u v))) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)))) → ∃ g : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ, LocallyIntegrableOn (fun v => g (z + ι v + ι' (u v))) (ball (0 : Euclid n) s) volume ∧ (∀ᵐ v ∂(volume.restrict (ball (0 : Euclid n) s)), ∃ m : ℤ, g (z + ι v + ι' (u v)) = m) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (n + k)) n) ⊆ {x | ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ∃ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) h, x = z + ι v + ι' w} → T ω = ∫ x in (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) s, g x * ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (n + k)) n) x) ∂μHE[n]
